newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin and Chirac to meet on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin and Chirac to meet on Sunday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will meet Russian President Boris Yeltsin during a stopover in Moscow on Sunday on his way back from China, a Kremlin press service spokesman said.
The spokesman could not say where the meeting would take place.
Russian officials said on Saturday that Chirac would have one hour of talks with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin at the Vnukovo-2 government airport at about 6 p.m. (1400 GMT).
The main issue of Chirac's talks in Moscow is likely to be Russian relations with NATO in the light of the planned signing of a treaty between Russia and the Western alliance in Paris on May 27.

Russian and NATO negotiators announced a deal last week on establishing a new relationship. The deal addressed some of the security concerns raised by Russia about the alliance's plans to expand eastwards and admit former Soviet-bloc countries in Eastern Europe.
